scope: DES z-band SCI and MSK cutouts are matched to the FGCM calibrated image basename and reprojected after approximate Gaussian FWHM matching. Nightly medians have no WGT weighting and subtract a reference made from other observing seasons. UTC night boundaries are at noon. Reported scatter describes local aperture residuals including blended light. Gaussian and Moffat injections are performed on residual coadds to measure recovery of persistent light during the sampled exposures without modelling individual exposure durations.
